integrity.computer_checks: Exact-rational algebra and finite numerical illustrations only; they are not infinite proofs.
integrity.proof: A weighted exact defect identity plus compactness, localized signed-square coercivity and recovery from the antiperiodic Sturm–Liouville ground state.

scientific_limitations: Positive periodic C1 weights and real fourth powers only.
Leading asymptotic only, with no closed form for the continuum coefficient at arbitrary weight.
Potential unindexed equivalent work remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Weighted odd-cycle fourth-power edge converges to an antiperiodic Sturm–Liouville eigenvalue
